title: KNN transfer from a vector index of library spectra
axis: scoring rule: A0 = z(nf) + 0.25 doc; A1 = A0 + beta * z(knn), knn = similarity-weighted Tanimoto of the candidate to the structures of the query's nearest library spectra
question: Do the structures of a query's nearest library spectra (in our model's spectrum embedding space) carry ranking information beyond our model and the documentation prior?
hypothesis: A1 beats A0 on np_c2 (primary) without losing on np_tims.

rules.index: every library spectrum the model w4base_s0 trained on (work/w4 with --val work/cells: holdout, np-examples and the work/cells registry hidden); asserted free of cell structures

knn.weights: softmax(cos / 0.05) over the union of the molecule's neighbours

rules.beta_selection: grid {0.25, 0.5, 1, 2}; the beta used on each cell is the best mean MRR on the OTHER cell (np_c2 <- np_tims, np_tims <- np_c2)
rules.leak_policy: every arm leak-free on every cell, and the index holds no spectrum of a cell structure, else void
rules.consequence: knn_helps -> the KNN term becomes a candidate signal for the pipeline's ranks 2-25 (to be replayed on eval-c3 before any LB use)
limitations: library structures only: the signal cannot name a structure absent from the library
